title: spec(contracts): the verified MCP access token result carries organizationId, the organization an OAuth consent bound (slice 1 of #24137, ruled A at 6232069920)
body:
Carries item 5, first slice, of #24137 (the `packages/spec` contract type); #24137 keeps the runtime read and its pins, and #24137's second upstream slice (`plugin-auth`'s consent binding) is filed beside this one.

**Filing gate ③**, a maintainer-directed task: ruled at `6232069920` on #24137, letter A, the maintainer's word 「同意」, recorded by the triage seat. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `os-sales` · session `session_01BVm1pAXVXQ3PjC42j1kPFf`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the ruling binds, for this slice

From `6232069920`, verbatim: "**Binding:** at consent, `plugin-auth` records the consenting user's current organization through the installed OAuth provider's declared seam (`postLogin.consentReferenceId` / `customAccessTokenClaims`). The access token carries it as the claim **`organization_id`**." Its execution plan names this slice: "The `packages/spec` contract type for the verified-token result. Spec seat, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`."

## The change

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts`, `verifyMcpAccessToken` (about `:297`, read on `origin/main` `52c04b360`): its result type `{ userId: string; scopes: string[]; clientId?: string }` gains the bound organization, as an optional `organizationId` member. It is absent for a token minted before the binding existed, and for an M2M token.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: a published contract type gains a member. The describe text / JSDoc says what it is: the organization the user's OAuth consent bound, read from the token's `organization_id` claim, and re-checked against a current membership by the caller on every request (ruling item 2).

## Reader who acts

The `domain:spec` seat (`packages/spec` is always its; this card self-labels `domain:spec` under the filer exception, so triage spot-checks the route). The `plugin-auth` slice waits on this one (its `Blocked-by:`), and #24137 waits on both.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included: `OAuth MCP access token organization claim consent bind organization verifyMcpAccessToken` gave 4 hits. #24137 is the parent. #20791 is the MCP distribution check, #16418 (closed) the M2M principal, and #16549 (closed) the OAuth agent ceiling. None is this contract member.

Dedupe words: verifyMcpAccessToken organizationId contract; OAuth token organization_id claim spec auth-service; MCP access token bound organization.
